title: Summer 1 review set: notation, constructions and angles (10 questions)
subject: Mathematics
unit: Summer 1: Geometric notation and constructions; geometric reasoning
source: Written for mathematics/y7 lesson 69 (Practise your target from the quiz: the portal's Summer 1 review set (10 questions).)
intro: Lesson 69 homework. Do the questions on your target topic first, then the rest. Show working and give reasons for angles.

questions.q: Name the vertex of angle PQR.
Two angles on a straight line are 47° and x. Find x.
questions.a: x = 180 - 47 = 133° (angles on a straight line add up to 180°)

questions.q: Angles of 110°, 85°, 90° and y meet at a point. Find y.
questions.a: y = 360 - 285 = 75° (angles at a point add up to 360°)

questions.q: Two straight lines cross. One angle is 38°. Find the other three.
questions.a: 38° (vertically opposite), 142° and 142° (angles on a straight line)

questions.q: A triangle has angles 48°, 67° and z. Find z.
questions.a: z = 180 - 115 = 65° (angles in a triangle add up to 180°)

questions.q: An isosceles triangle has base angles of 72°. Find the top angle.
A quadrilateral has angles 95°, 80°, 110° and w. Find w.
questions.a: w = 360 - 285 = 75° (angles in a quadrilateral add up to 360°)

questions.q: Angles x, 3x and 2x lie on a straight line. Find x.
Construct a triangle with sides 7 cm, 6 cm and 5 cm (SSS). Leave your arcs. Measure the largest angle.
questions.a: The largest angle is opposite the 7 cm side: about 78° (accept 76° to 80°)
